procedure: DGX H100 Front Fan Module Replacement

events.label: failed_fan_identified
events.description: Failed fan module identified from BMC sensor data, the nvsm show fans output, or its lit fault LED

events.label: new_fan_unpacked
events.description: New fan module taken out of its packaging and held ready to install

events.label: bezel_removed
events.description: Front bezel removed from the system, exposing the fan modules

events.label: fan_unlocked
events.description: Release button on the failed fan module pressed to unlock it

events.label: fan_removed
events.description: Failed fan module pulled fully out of its bay

events.label: fan_inserted
events.description: New fan module pushed fully into the empty fan bay

events.label: fan_health_verified
events.description: New fan confirmed healthy: amber LED off, or BMC sensors or nvsm show fans checked

events.label: bezel_installed
events.description: Front bezel reinstalled on the system

requirements.statement: Identify the failed fan module through the BMC, nvsm, or its fault LED before removing it
requirements.quote: Identify failed front fan module through BMC

requirements.statement: Take the new fan module out of its packaging and be ready to install it before removing the old one
requirements.quote: Remove the new fan module from its packaging

requirements.statement: Replace the old fan with the new one within 30 seconds to avoid overheating system components
Remove the bezel to expose the fan modules before removing a fan
Unlock the fan module by pressing the release button before pulling it out
Confirm the new fan module is healthy through the BMC, its amber LED, or nvsm show fans
requirements.quote: Confirm that the fan module is healthy

requirements.statement: Check fan health after the new fan module is installed
requirements.quote: Confirm that the fan module is healthy

requirements.statement: Reinstall the bezel when the replacement is complete
